**pi:** the Pi package now runs the prompt-submit brief through `pixel run-hook task-event --provider pi` (no task ledger, the configured `brief_parts` budget, read feedback, daemon warm-start, the `🟩` line as a user-only notification) and relays the finalized metrics line after a `pixel` bash call through the new `pixel run-hook metrics --provider pi`. `pixel doctor` flags a package from an earlier release; rerun `pixel setup`.
